question: Which continuous, signal-grounded LONG spectro-temporal measurements differ consistently between original Bass observations preserved versus missed by the frozen controlled-mix to htdemucs_ft to JGA path across CED-VAL-005, CED-VAL-006 and CED-VAL-009?
population_authority: Use each dataset's already-frozen original-event identifiers and frozen one-to-one correspondence labels without redefining timestamps, matching, PRESERVED or MISSED.
coordinate_window: Inclusive +/-0.050 seconds around each frozen original Bass observation, using LONG global frame-start coordinates; no timestamp correction.

measurements.local_log_spectral_level_max: maximum across window frames of log10(sum frozen 0-2000 Hz power + float64 tiny)
measurements.local_log_spectral_level_median: median across window frames of log10(sum frozen 0-2000 Hz power + float64 tiny)
measurements.local_time_frequency_contrast: window maximum minus window median log spectral level
measurements.partial_prominence_dispersion_at_max_sco: population standard deviation across eight partial_prominence values at the node with maximum score; tie earliest frame then lowest F0 index
measurements.partial_prominence_entropy_at_max_score: Shannon entropy of the eight nonnegative partial_prominence values normalized by their sum at the maximum-score node; zero if sum is zero
measurements.fixed_f0_persistence_mean: mean score_lattice value at the maximum-emergence node's F0 index across frames [f-4,f+4] clipped to available frames
measurements.maximum_fullband_positive_spectral_flux: maximum across window frames of sum(max(spectrum[f]-spectrum[f-1],0))/(sum(spectrum[f-1])+epsilon); first global frame value zero
measurements.maximum_lowband_positive_spectral_flux: same normalized positive flux restricted to frozen spectrum bins <=250 Hz
measurements.competing_node_count: number of local-F0 nodes in the window
measurements.f0_hypothesis_count: number of unique F0 grid indices in the window
measurements.node_per_f0_crowding: competing_node_count divided by f0_hypothesis_count; unavailable when denominator zero

tie_policy: For any node-selected measurement, ties are earliest global frame then lowest F0-grid index.
unavailable_measurement: Preserve as null with explicit reason when no complete LONG frame or no mathematical local maximum exists; do not impute. A feature is INDETERMINATE if either population has less than 80 percent availability in any dataset.

statistics.per_dataset_population_summary: n available, n unavailable, minimum, Q1, median, Q3, maximum
statistics.comparison: PRESERVED minus MISSED direction; Cliff's delta; rank AUC=P(PRESERVED>MISSED)+0.5*P(tie); two-sided Mann-Whitney U reported descriptively
statistics.uncertainty: 95 percent percentile bootstrap CI for Cliff's delta, 10000 deterministic resamples within each population, NumPy PCG64 seed 20260901 plus dataset ordinal times 1000 plus feature ordinal
statistics.no_selection: No multiplicity-driven feature deletion, p-value selection, classifier, composite score or threshold fitting

cross_dataset_classification.magnitude_authority: absolute Cliff's delta: negligible <0.147; small 0.147-<0.33; medium 0.33-<0.474; large >=0.474
cross_dataset_classification.CONSISTENT: all three dataset deltas are non-negligible and have the same sign
cross_dataset_classification.MATERIAL_DEPENDENT: at least one dataset delta is non-negligible and CONSISTENT is not satisfied
cross_dataset_classification.WEAK: all three dataset deltas are negligible
cross_dataset_classification.INDETERMINATE: availability gate fails or a required authority/integrity/replay invariant fails
cross_dataset_classification.priority: INDETERMINATE, then CONSISTENT, then MATERIAL_DEPENDENT, then WEAK

interpretation: Effects describe association with preservation status within these frozen materials. They do not establish causation, source identity, physical onset, a detector, a recovery rule, or general applicability.
protocol_fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of jq -cS JSON after deleting protocol_fingerprint, including one trailing LF
